intuition.title: Study context: Source-proposed LSS mechanism
intuition.text: The authors describe ion exchange from aqueous metal ions into solid metal linoleate, interfacial reaction, hydrophobic fatty-acid-associated surfaces and spontaneous separation. Figure 3 is their mechanistic scheme, not measured molecular or particle coordinates. Its reduction-by-ethanol step applies to noble metals; other material families use different interfacial chemistry.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, LSS mechanism and Figure 3

intuition.title: Study context: Noble-metal quantities have bounded scope
intuition.text: The typical noble-metal recipe specifies 20 mL aqueous salt solution with an example 0.5 g salt charge, 1.6 g sodium linoleate, 10 mL ethanol and 2 mL linoleic acid in a 40 mL autoclave, sealed for 10 h. AgNO3 and HAuCl4 are named; other soluble chlorides are unspecified. No hydration state or exact salt identity is added. Other fatty acids and corresponding salts are stated alternatives, not extra quantified runs.

intuition.title: Study context: Ranges are not a series of invented experiments
intuition.text: Source family temperatures are Ag 80–200 °C; Ru/Rh/Ir 20–200 °C; Au/Pd/Pt 20–100 °C. Ag/Au diameter can vary about 4–15 nm, and Ru/Rh/Ir/Pd/Pt are about 3 nm or less. Specific Figure 1 captions retain their own means, uncertainty and temperature. SI tuning series were not reviewed.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Noble metals and Figure 1a

intuition.title: Study context: Different non-noble reactions retain missing inputs
intuition.text: The source names sulfide from Na2S or (NH4)2S, selenide from SeO3(2−) reduced by N2H4, and fluoride from NaF or NH4F. Figure captions supply selected ratios and temperatures. Unassigned alternatives remain unresolved and the noble-metal 10 h/liquid charges are not transferred. Barium titanate alone has the stated 7 g NaOH, 0.5 g Ba(NO3)2 and equal TiCl3 moles; TiO2 has 1 mL 30% TiCl3 for a 40 mL vessel.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Material families and Figure 1 caption

intuition.title: Study context: Hierarchical sizes and source discrepancies
intuition.text: YF3 rice-like assemblies are approximately 100 nm across and 500 nm long, composed of approximately 5 nm nanocrystals. The NaYF4/LaF3/YbF3 family range 4–12 nm and Ln(OH)3 nanorod diameters 3–15 nm vary with temperature and do not become extra specimen means. CoFe2O4 caption 11.5±0.6 nm is retained separately from the prose approximation of about 10 nm.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figure 1 caption and morphology discussion

intuition.title: Study context: Characterization and processing context
intuition.text: TEM-grid assembly occurs after solvent evaporation; original image scales are not size averages. Figure 2 CdS is not the Figure 1 CdSe specimen. Cyclohexane/chloroform dispersions are usually stable for months; Figure 4 calls 2% a typical concentration without specifying percentage basis. Drop/dip coating, ethanol reprecipitation and external-field separation are qualitative downstream possibilities, without exact dose/schedule or new synthesis measurements.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–4, TEM arrays, Figures 2/4 and processing discussion

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
